state: Personal scope approved by root; DTO/date/food snapshot preparation exists in new modules only. Persistence, API/UI integration and schema review remain open.

existing.storage: mb_daily_DATE, mb_water_DATE, mb_meals_DATE and mb_meals_done_DATE in localStorage without an account owner
existing.progress: renderPlan currently derives daily goal progress from menu kcal before any consumed food is recorded
existing.server: No diary API or persistence model exists; ClientProgress is for body measurements and must not absorb meals or water

integration_after_r11_checkpoint: web/routes/usuario.py: only expose the authorized source plan ID if necessary
backend_agreement_required: schema_control expected revision and target table count
ownership_proposed.current_schema_gate: R04 preparation is frozen at 23 tables; B2B generation reservation is scheduled as table 24. Diary and object metadata follow as tables 25/26 according to the actual reviewed order; no fixed new revision is assumed.

authority.context: personal; a professional tipo usuario retains this separate space
authority.request_authority_fields: No user_id, gym_id, tenant, sharing permissions or timezone supplied by a client
authority.sharing: No gym/client access is granted; explicit R12 linkage and consent remain separate
authority.date: ISO local_date, server-derived today in America/Mexico_City; timezone included in every response and persisted record
authority.legacy_browser_data: No automatic import or attribution of old localStorage keys whose owner is unknown

fields: source_plan_id nullable FK planes_generados ON DELETE SET NULL
invariants: source plan belongs to the authenticated personal user
resolved snapshot survives deletion of source plan
persistence_proposed.isolation: RLS subject equals user_id; transaction middleware already scopes /api/usuario/ to canonical personal identity
persistence_proposed.concurrency: Conditional version update and unique first-insert arbitration; conflicting writes return 409 rather than silently replacing a newer device's state

api_proposed.GET /api/usuario/diario/today: Canonical server today, timezone and persisted or explicit empty day
api_proposed.GET /api/usuario/diario?start=YYYY-MM-DD: Authenticated bounded calendar range with saved summaries
api_proposed.GET /api/usuario/diario/{local_date}: One explicit day, including version and stable record ID if persisted
api_proposed.PATCH /api/usuario/diario/{local_date}: Discriminated operation water/meal/completion plus strict expected_version. A meal update replaces only that meal, preserving earlier meals and their individual plan source/snapshot.
api_proposed.food_input: Source plan ID, meal and bounded option indices; vegetables require an explicit include_vegetables boolean. Food labels, portions and nutritional totals are derived from the authorized persisted source.
api_proposed.truth: Menu generation never records consumption. Explicit food save records selected consumed foods; completion count is labelled independently from tracked kcal
api_proposed.http: No-store responses; malformed input, invalid day, expired session, conflict and storage failures are distinguishable and never produce a saved toast

ui_states: Loading: consumption controls wait for canonical diary state
Empty: no records today; consumed kcal zero even when a complete menu exists
Saved: canonical server response and explicit date/timezone shown
Unsaved: failed mutation preserves the form and offers retry without claiming persistence
Conflict: explain newer change and offer reload before replacing it
Date rollover: refresh server today on focus and before save; do not write a previous day's open form into a new day silently
Plan changed: do not reinterpret saved option indices under another plan; retain snapshot and require an explicit food update
History: bounded month fetch, loading/error/empty separated, timezone consistent with the diary
validation_required: Two authenticated devices load the same saved water/food/completion state
Logout and relogin preserve database history without relying on browser data
Switch between two accounts in one browser never displays or writes the other account's day
Professional membership and its revocation preserve the independent diary
Other user's source plan is rejected; forged owner, tenant or nutritional totals rejected
Mexico City 23:59 to 00:00 and UTC date difference yield the correct local_date
Concurrent first insert and stale version writes preserve one accepted version and reject the stale mutation
Calendar uses the persisted range instead of old mb_daily keys; source plan deletion retains resolved snapshot
API failures do not close a form as saved or leave a false progress state
Keyboard, focus, labels, contrast and 320/390/768/1440 responsive regression checks
remaining_decisions: Exact schema revision scheduling and ownership after R04 preparation gate
Whole-day single source_plan_id versus per-meal source plan snapshots for changing menus within one day; avoid silently replacing already recorded consumption
Authorized manual import, export and retention are later explicit work, not inferred from old browser storage
environment: Local synthetic validation only; no provider, production account, deployment or real email

preparation.validation: 27 pure value tests pass: Mexico midnight/UTC difference, strict authority-free input, own-plan food snapshot, explicit vegetables, finite/corrupt numeric data, future write and bounded date ranges
preparation.limit: No active endpoint, table, migration, DB CAS, synchronization, logout history or UI integration yet; these pure tests do not close R14.
